Validate state-vocabulary consistency within each inner-pool group.

Source: R/pool_by.R
dot-validate_state_pool_vocab.Rd

Internal helper used by mt_clean_track when both pool_by and state = are supplied. For each inner pool group (the operating unit) containing more than one track, this checks that every pairwise non-NA state vocabulary intersection within the group is non-empty. Outer-group consistency is not enforced – the outer group is a fit source, not a union target.

Usage

.validate_state_pool_vocab(state_by_track, inner_map)

Arguments

state_by_track

Named list, track id (as character) -> the vector of state labels observed in that track (after NA strip).

inner_map

Named character vector from .resolve_pool_groups()$inner.

Value

Invisibly TRUE on success; raises an informative error on disjoint vocabulary.

Details

"Missing states" (a state in track A that never appears in track B) is fine – only entirely disjoint vocabularies count as a mismatch.
